# Chesed — Reader Revelation Vision

The Awtsmoos renews each word before the eye can finish one line;
Awtsmoos.com should let Torah occupy the foreground while every control waits for its proper time.

## Evidence already proven

- Native reader shell is `heichelos/post/_awtsmoos.post.html`.
- Critical shell CSS is already extracted into `styles/reader-controls/critical-shell.css` and `live-template.css`.
- The reader root owns a local scope: `.post-reader-localized-context`.
- Typography, theme, font, preferences, focus mode, auto-scroll, command palette, sidebar, comments, and reading intelligence already have modular JavaScript homes.
- Advanced appearance already uses native `<details>`, proving progressive disclosure is an established reader language.
- The current floating controls are `#typographyBtn` and `#commentaryBtn`; reader settings live in `#typographyDetails`.

## Product goal

Make the text itself feel sovereign. Reader controls should be reachable in one gesture, obvious by keyboard, safe on notched mobile screens, and visually quiet when unused. Settings should reveal progressively by human intent, never as a permanent dashboard wall.

## Extreme but coherent improvements

- One local reader z-layer vocabulary instead of literal escalation.
- Safe-area-aware floating controls and settings surfaces.
- State-rich controls with hover-capable hover, active, focus-visible, pressed/expanded, disabled, and reduced-motion behavior.
- Settings hierarchy: daily reading controls first; advanced appearance, automation, and reset separated by semantic disclosure.
- Sidebar and typography surfaces should coordinate rather than overlap each other.
- Reader shell state should be idempotent and testable through small gate/controller classes.
- No new global selector, global variable, or unrelated page contract.
